doc.title: Annie Ross interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001

title: Closing thanks and the Blue Note engagement
summary: Rowe thanks her and mentions her upcoming Blue Note engagement.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I look forward to it and I want to thank you for your time this evening. This was most enjoyable.
And it was enjoyable for me.
Good, I’m glad. And best of luck with your book and the upcoming Blue Note engagement.
Yeah, I’m sure it will be. It will be another excuse to come back.
Well listen thank you so much again and I appreciate it.
Oh, I’ve had a good time.
Good. Thank you. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-
